scenario: A global debate camp selects participants with high argument quality OR strong delivery skills. Both traits are independent in the applicant population. Among selected participants, the OR-gate mechanism makes the two traits appear negatively correlated.

data.description: Population base rates and OR-gate selection mechanism

values.selection_rule: OR gate: selected if argument quality OR delivery skill

question: (a) What is P(selected)? (b) What is P(argument_quality|not_delivery_skill, selected)? (c) What is P(argument_quality|delivery_skill, selected)? (d) Explain why argument quality and delivery skill appear negatively correlated among selected candidates even though they are independent in the population.

ground_truth.explanation: Under OR-gate selection, a candidate lacking delivery skill must have argument quality to be selected (P=1.0). A candidate who has delivery skill is selected regardless of argument quality, so P(argument quality | delivery skill, selected) = P(argument quality) = 0.38. This differential probability creates a negative within-selected correlation despite population independence.

naive_answer: The negative correlation among selected candidates reflects a genuine inverse relationship between argument quality and delivery skill in the domain.
naive_trap: The negative correlation is entirely an artefact of OR-gate collider selection, not a real population-level relationship between the two traits.
reasoning_trace: (1) P(sel)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A)P(B)=0.38+0.52-0.38×0.52=0.7024. (2) If not-B and selected, must have A → P(A|not-B,sel)=1.0. (3) If B and selected, selection is independent of A → P(A|B,sel)=P(A)=0.38. (4) The gap between 1.0 and 0.38 produces a negative association within the selected group via collider bias.
python_verification:
pA,pB = 0.38,0.52
pSel = pA+pB-pA*pB
assert abs(pSel-0.7024)<0.005
pA_notB_sel = pA*(1-pB)/(pA*(1-pB))   # =1.0
assert abs(pA_notB_sel-1.0)<0.005
pA_B_sel = pA*pB/pB                    # =pA
assert abs(pA_B_sel-pA)<0.005
assert pA_notB_sel > pA_B_sel          # negative collider bias confirmed
